g.title: ModuleDependencies
g.text: Module dependency graph — one node per source directory actually built by CMake
(preset V71_EK_hello_world: APP=Hello_world, TARGET=V71_EK_hello_world, BOARD=V71_EK, PLATFORM=SamV71) (arrow: module → module it depends on)
solid = #include dependency dashed = C++20 module import bold red = two-way (circular) dependency between the pair
